newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: RTRS-Petroz says completes Bayu appraisal.
newsitem.headline: RTRS-Petroz says completes Bayu appraisal.

text.p: Petroz NL said on Tuesday the Bayu-5 gas well, located in the ZOCA 91-13 block of the Timor Sea, has successfully appraised the southeastern part of the Bayu-Undan gas and condensate field.
The well encountered a 56-metre gross hydrocarbon column with the same hydrocarbon water contact as that interesected in nine other wells drilled on the field, Petroz said.
Flow testing was not considered necessary and the well was plugged and abandoned, Petroz said.
